```{r packages}
## Primula vital rates with climate data

library(tidyverse)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(lme4)
library(patchwork) #for putting plots into one
library(popbio)
library(glmmTMB)

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 18)) #for ggplot
```

```{r}
lom <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "Lomatium_Demography_Data_CLEANED_2016thru2026.csv"))
lom.germ.rate <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "Lomatium_seed_germination_rates.csv"))
climate <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "CGOP_climatevalues_scaled.csv"))
climate<- climate %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(across(-year, ~lag(.x), .names = "prev_{.col}"))#%>% 
  # select(c(year, winter.mean.min.temp, prev_winter.mean.min.temp, summer.mean.max.temp, prev_summer.mean.max.temp, spring.mean.temp, prev_spring.mean.temp, fall.mean.temp, prev_fall.mean.temp, ends_with("tot.precip")))

# size.t = log(No.leaves.t * Leaf.length.t)
lom <- left_join(lom, climate, by = c("Year" = "year"))
lom <- lom %>% 
  group_by(plantid) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year), 
         Plot = as.factor(Plot),
          psurvival = factor(psurvival, levels = c(0, 1)),
          psurvivalT1 = as.character(psurvivalT1),
         psurvivalT1 = factor(psurvivalT1, levels = c(0, 1)),
         pflower = factor(pflower, levels = c(0, 1)),
         pflowerT1 = factor(pflowerT1, levels = c(0, 1)),
         pseeds = factor(pseeds, levels = c(0, 1)),
    size = if_else(No.leaves > 0 & Leaf.length>0, log(No.leaves* Leaf.length), NA),
    sizeT1 = lead(size),
    trt = as.factor(trt),
    trt = fct_relevel(trt, "irrigated", "control", "drought")) %>% 
  filter(Plot != "11",
         Year != "2016") #no. leaves were miscounted

lom.surv <- lom %>% 
  filter(!Year %in% c("2025", "2026"),
  !is.na(psurvivalT1))

seeds <- lom %>% 
  filter(!is.na(no.seeds))

#to do: get lomatium seedlings (size dist of new recruits)
lom.new <- lom %>%
  group_by(plantid) %>%
  slice_min(as.numeric(as.character(Year)), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(Year != "2017")%>% 
  filter(pflower !="1", !is.na(pflower), !is.na(Leaf.length), No.leaves <2& Leaf.length<10)

hist(lom.new$size)
#parameters for new plants
new_sd <- sd(lom.new$size)
new_mean <- mean(lom.new$size, na.rm = T)

#Define the min and max size, which are the integration bounds of the IPM.
minRealsize <- min(lom$size, na.rm=T) 
maxRealsize <- 1.1* max(lom$size,na.rm=T)

#now add a new min & max size to keep the plants in for eviction
min.size <-minRealsize-1 #lower
max.size <-maxRealsize+1.5 #upper
```



```{r parameters , echo=FALSE}
#this is for range of climates
rows <- expand.grid(summer.mean.min.temp = seq(-1, 1, by = 1),winter.mean.max.temp = seq(-1, 1, by = 1),fall.mean.temp = seq(-1, 1, by = 1), prev_summer.mean.min.temp = seq(-1, 1, by = 1), trt = c("irrigated", "control", "drought")) 
#set up an empty parameter df
params=data.frame(
	growth.int = c(NA),
	growth.slope  = NA,
	growth.sd=NA,
	surv.int=NA,
	surv.slope=NA,
	pflow.int = NA,
	pflow.slope = NA,
	pseeds.int=NA,
	pseeds.slope=NA,
	no.seeds.int=NA,
	no.seeds.slope=NA,
	recruit.size.mean=NA,
	recruit.size.sd=NA,
	pest = NA
)
params <- bind_cols(params, rows)
```

```{r}
### 1. Growth
gm.s.min.temp.trt.int4 <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*trt + trt*summer.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
growth <- fixef(gm.s.min.temp.trt.int4)

params <- params %>%
  mutate(
    growth.int = case_when(
      trt == "irrigated" ~ growth["(Intercept)"] + growth["summer.mean.min.temp"]*summer.mean.min.temp,
      trt == "control"   ~ growth["(Intercept)"] + growth["trtcontrol"]+ growth["summer.mean.min.temp"]*summer.mean.min.temp + growth["trtcontrol:summer.mean.min.temp"]*summer.mean.min.temp,
      trt == "drought"   ~ growth["(Intercept)"] + growth["trtdrought"]+ growth["summer.mean.min.temp"]*summer.mean.min.temp + growth["trtdrought:summer.mean.min.temp"]*summer.mean.min.temp),
    growth.slope = case_when(
      trt == "irrigated" ~ growth["size"],
      trt == "control"   ~ growth["size"] + growth["size:trtcontrol"],
      trt == "drought"   ~ growth["size"] + growth["size:trtdrought"]))

growth_var <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(gm.s.min.temp.trt.int4))
params$growth.sd <- growth_var[growth_var$grp == "Residual", "sdcor"]

### 2. pflower
fm.wt.trt.int4 <- glmer(pflower ~ size*trt + trt*winter.mean.max.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, family = "binomial")
flowering <- fixef(fm.wt.trt.int4)

params <- params %>%
  mutate(
    pflow.int = case_when(
      trt == "irrigated" ~ flowering["(Intercept)"] + flowering["winter.mean.max.temp"]*winter.mean.max.temp,
      trt == "control"  ~ flowering["(Intercept)"] + flowering["trtcontrol"] + flowering["winter.mean.max.temp"]*winter.mean.max.temp + flowering["trtcontrol:winter.mean.max.temp"]*winter.mean.max.temp,
      trt == "drought"  ~ flowering["(Intercept)"] + flowering["trtdrought"] + flowering["winter.mean.max.temp"]*winter.mean.max.temp + flowering["trtdrought:winter.mean.max.temp"]*winter.mean.max.temp),
    pflow.slope = case_when(
      trt == "irrigated" ~ flowering["size"],
      trt == "control"   ~ flowering["size"] + flowering["size:trtcontrol"],
      trt == "drought"   ~ flowering["size"] + flowering["size:trtdrought"]))

### 3. survival
sm.f.int2 <- glmer(psurvivalT1 ~ size + fall.mean.temp*trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom.surv, family = "binomial")
survival <- fixef(sm.f.int2)

params <- params %>%
  mutate(
    surv.slope = survival["size"],
    surv.int = case_when(
      trt == "irrigated" ~ survival["(Intercept)"] + survival["fall.mean.temp"] * fall.mean.temp,
      trt == "control"   ~ survival["(Intercept)"] + survival["fall.mean.temp"] * fall.mean.temp +
      survival["trtcontrol"] + survival["fall.mean.temp:trtcontrol"] * fall.mean.temp,
      trt == "drought"   ~ survival["(Intercept)"] + survival["fall.mean.temp"] * fall.mean.temp +
      survival["trtdrought"] + survival["fall.mean.temp:trtdrought"] * fall.mean.temp))


### 4. pseeds
ps.s.t.int <- glmer(pseeds ~ size*prev_summer.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = seeds, family = "binomial")
pseeds <- fixef(ps.s.t.int)

params <- params %>%
  mutate(
    pseeds.slope = pseeds["size"] +
     pseeds["size:prev_summer.mean.min.temp"] * prev_summer.mean.min.temp,
    pseeds.int = pseeds["(Intercept)"] +
     pseeds["prev_summer.mean.min.temp"] * prev_summer.mean.min.temp
  )
### 5. noseeds:
poisson.s.trt3 <- glmmTMB(no.seeds ~ size*trt + prev_summer.mean.min.temp+ (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = subset(seeds, no.seeds>0), family = truncated_nbinom2)
no.seeds <- fixef(poisson.s.trt3)

no.seeds.coef <- fixef(poisson.s.trt3)$cond
theta <- sigma(poisson.s.trt3)

params <- params %>%
  mutate(
    no.seeds.int = case_when(
      trt == "irrigated" ~ no.seeds.coef["(Intercept)"] +
        no.seeds.coef["prev_summer.mean.min.temp"] * prev_summer.mean.min.temp,
      trt == "control"   ~ no.seeds.coef["(Intercept)"] + no.seeds.coef["trtcontrol"] +
        no.seeds.coef["prev_summer.mean.min.temp"] * prev_summer.mean.min.temp,
      trt == "drought"   ~ no.seeds.coef["(Intercept)"] + no.seeds.coef["trtdrought"] +
        no.seeds.coef["prev_summer.mean.min.temp"] * prev_summer.mean.min.temp),
    no.seeds.slope = case_when(
      trt == "irrigated" ~ no.seeds.coef["size"],
      trt == "control"   ~ no.seeds.coef["size"] + no.seeds.coef["size:trtcontrol"],
      trt == "drought"   ~ no.seeds.coef["size"] + no.seeds.coef["size:trtdrought"]),
    no.seeds.theta = theta)

#params$no.seeds <- no.seeds
params$pest <- 0.00696
params$recruit.size.mean <- new_mean # mean new >1 leaf plant size
params$recruit.size.sd<- new_sd # sd of new >1 leaf plant size
```

```{r}
###~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
###         Load functions
###~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#SURVIVAL AT SIZE X
s.x=function(x,params) {
	u=exp(params$surv.int+params$surv.slope*x)
	return(u/(1+u))
}

#how to test this: 
### run function for a plant of size 1 and for the first row of parameters
#s.x(x = 5, params = params[1,])
### run function for a plant of size 1 but for all rows of parameters (so get a list )
#s.x(x = 1, params = params)
#ok this works and seems to work for all rows of params. great.

#GROWTH FROM SIZE X TO Y; 
  ## returns a *probability density distribution* for each x value
g.yx<-function(y,x,params){
    # eviction here...
  xb=pmin(pmax(x,minRealsize),maxRealsize) #Transforms all values below/above limits in min/max size (floor & ceiling)
  growth_to_newsize <-params$growth.int + params$growth.slope*xb
  growth_sd <- params$growth.sd
  return(dnorm(y,mean=growth_to_newsize,sd=growth_sd))
  #dnorm(y,mean=params$growth.int + params$growth.slope*x,sd=params$growth.sd)
}

#Tom Miller's combined s and g kernel
P <- function(y, x, params){
  s.x(x, params)*g.yx(y, x, params)
}

#PROBABILITY OF FLOWERING OF SIZE X individuals
pf.x <-function(x,params){
	u<-exp(params$pflow.int+params$pflow.slope*x)
	return(u/(1+u))
}

# Probability of producing seeds for plant size x
ps.x <- function(x, params) {
  u <- exp(params$pseeds.int + params$pseeds.slope * x)
  u / (1 + u)
}
#testing this for a plant of size 5
#pf.x(x = 3,params = params)

# f.yx <- function(x,params) { 		
#   return(pf.x(x,params)*exp(params$no.flow.int+params$no.flow.slope*x)* params$pest)
# }
# f.yx <- function(x, params) {
#   pf.x(x, params) * ps.x(x, params) * exp(params$no.seeds.int + params$no.seeds.slope * x) * params$pest
# }
f.yx <- function(x, params) {
  # expected seeds per seed-setting plant (zero-truncated negative binomial mean)
  mu    <- exp(params$no.seeds.int + params$no.seeds.slope * x)
  theta <- params$no.seeds.theta
  p0    <- (theta / (theta + mu))^theta       # P(0 seeds) under the untruncated NB
  seeds.given.seeds <- mu / (1 - p0)

  pf.x(x, params) *            # probability of flowering
    ps.x(x, params) *          # probability of producing seeds
    seeds.given.seeds *        # expected number of seeds, given some are produced
    params$pest                # establishment (seed to seedling)
}
##so this should be outputting the number of seedlings made? Yes
#f.yx(x = 6, params = params[1,])


##do big plants make a million seeds?
#exp(params$no.seeds.int+params$no.seeds.slope*5) 
## no they make a reasonable amount

#SIZE DISTRIBUTION OF RECRUITS - so the ones going from the continuous into the continuous stage. 
#reutens the probability density for size of a new recruit
recruit.size<-function(y,params){
    ## returns a *probability density distribution*
  dnorm(y,mean=params$recruit.size.mean,sd=params$recruit.size.sd)
}
#recruit.size(y = 1, params = params)
```

```{r}
params_list <-  filter(params) %>% split(., seq(nrow(.))) #this splits up params into X rows, which I can feed into the function below

###
mat.size = 100 #dimensions of continuous matrix
bigmatrix <- function(params_list, mat.size){

  n <- mat.size
  L <- min.size
  U <- max.size

  # mesh
  h <- (U - L) / n
  b <- L + c(0:n) * h
  y <- 0.5 * (b[1:n] + b[2:(n+1)])

  # Fertility matrix
  Fmat <- matrix(0, n, n)

  # recruits of size y from parent size x
  Fmat <- outer(y, y, function(y,x){
    f.yx(x, params_list) * recruit.size(y, params_list)
  }) * h

  # Growth/survival
  Tmat <- (outer(y, y, P, params = params_list)) * h

  # Full kernel
  IPMmat <- Fmat + Tmat

  out_matrix <- list(
    IPMmat = IPMmat,
    Fmat = Fmat,
    Tmat = Tmat,
    meshpts = y)

  out_lamb <- data.frame(
    lambda = lambda(IPMmat),
    summer.mean.min.temp = params_list$summer.mean.min.temp,
    winter.mean.max.temp = params_list$winter.mean.max.temp,
    fall.mean.temp = params_list$fall.mean.temp,
    prev_summer.mean.min.temp = params_list$prev_summer.mean.min.temp,
    trt = params_list$trt)

  return(out_lamb)
}

#what I want returned is lambdas
lamb_lists <- lapply(X = params_list, FUN = bigmatrix, mat.size = mat.size) #for each row of params_list, run the big matrix function!

#great~! now make it a df
lom_lambda <- do.call(rbind, lamb_lists)

```

Sensitivity:
```{r}
params.sens <- params |> 
  filter(summer.mean.min.temp ==0,
    winter.mean.max.temp ==0,
    fall.mean.temp ==0,
    prev_summer.mean.min.temp ==0)

perturb_params <- c(
'growth.int',
	'growth.slope',
	'growth.sd',
	'surv.int',
	'surv.slope',
	'pflow.int',
	'pflow.slope',
	"pseeds.int",
	'pseeds.slope',
	'no.seeds.int',
	'no.seeds.slope',
	'recruit.size.mean',
	'recruit.size.sd',
	'pest'
)

# create one perturbed row per parameter
params.sens <- bind_rows(
  params.sens %>% mutate(parameter = "baseline"),
  lapply(perturb_params, function(p) {
    x <- params.sens
    x[[p]] <- x[[p]] * 1.1
    x$parameter <- p
    x
  })
)
```

PEST simulations:
```{r}
base <- params |>
  filter(summer.mean.min.temp == 0,
         winter.mean.max.temp == 0,
         fall.mean.temp == 0,
         prev_summer.mean.min.temp == 0)

orig.pest    <- unique(base$pest)
orig.recruit <- unique(base$recruit.size.mean)

pest.values   <- sort(unique(c(seq(0.00001, 0.04, length.out = 200), orig.pest)))
recruit.means <- sort(unique(c(seq(0.5, 3.5, length.out =20), orig.recruit)))

# sweep 1: vary pest, recruit.size.mean stays original
pest.sim <- base |>
  select(-pest) |>
  crossing(pest = pest.values) |> 
  mutate(sim = "pestab")

# sweep 2: vary recruit.size.mean, pest stays original
recruit.sim <- base |>
  select(-recruit.size.mean) |>
  crossing(recruit.size.mean = recruit.means) |> 
    mutate(sim = "recruit.size.mean")


params.pest <- bind_rows(pest.sim, recruit.sim)
```

```{r}
params_list <-  params.pest %>% split(., seq(nrow(.))) #this splits up params into X rows, which I can feed into the function below

###
mat.size = 100 #dimensions of continuous matrix
bigmatrix <- function(params_list, mat.size){

  n <- mat.size
  L <- min.size
  U <- max.size

  # mesh
  h <- (U - L) / n
  b <- L + c(0:n) * h
  y <- 0.5 * (b[1:n] + b[2:(n+1)])

  # Fertility matrix
  Fmat <- matrix(0, n, n)

  # recruits of size y from parent size x
  Fmat <- outer(y, y, function(y,x){
    f.yx(x, params_list) * recruit.size(y, params_list)
  }) * h

  # Growth/survival
  Tmat <- (outer(y, y, P, params = params_list)) * h

  # Full kernel
  IPMmat <- Fmat + Tmat

  out_matrix <- list(
    IPMmat = IPMmat,
    Fmat = Fmat,
    Tmat = Tmat,
    meshpts = y)

  out_lamb <- data.frame(
    lambda = lambda(IPMmat),
    pest = params_list$pest,
    sim = params_list$sim,
    recruit.size.mean = params_list$recruit.size.mean,
    trt = params_list$trt)

  return(out_lamb)
}

#what I want returned is lambdas
lamb_lists <- lapply(X = params_list, FUN = bigmatrix, mat.size = mat.size) #for each row of params_list, run the big matrix function!

#great~! now make it a df
sim_results <- do.call(rbind, lamb_lists)

```

```{r}
  ggplot(aes(pest, lambda, colour = trt)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3088a3", "#9fb764", "#e54e21"))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.00905, linetype = "longdash", colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = orig.pest, linetype = "dashed", colour = "lightblue") +
  labs(x = "Germination rate (pest)",
       y = expression(lambda), colour = "") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14))

# Plot 2: recruit size sweep
(p.recruit <- sim_results |>
  filter(sim == "recruit.size.mean") |>
  ggplot(aes(recruit.size.mean, lambda, colour = trt)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3088a3", "#9fb764", "#e54e21"))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = orig.recruit, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Mean recruit size",
       y = expression(lambda), colour = "") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14))

(sims <- p.pest + p.recruit + plot_layout(guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
ggsave(here("Figures", "Lomatium", "constant.parameter.simulations.png"), plot = sims, width = 12, height =6)

```
